thesis: Northline sells make-slots, not mood boards: open on the Field Tote plate with trade facts on the plate edge; primary argument is hide grade via the Hide Grade Strip plus DKK 890–2.400 and a 3-week make-slot request — never lifestyle hero, purple SaaS gradient, or fake star rows.
signature: Hide Grade Strip — horizontal hide-grade chips (material swatch wells + ink-brown labels) under the Field Tote plate; the single control that binds plate → grade → make-slot request.
